title: MY wife and created a brotato like game for a jam
author: behzad_robot
selftext:
[https://meowmeow-bangbang.behzadrobot-hf8qf.arvanedge.ir/](https://meowmeow-bangbang.behzadrobot-hf8qf.arvanedge.ir/)  
My wife and i both love brotato and survivors like genre and decided to create a game with some spice based on our previous small game ( [Neon's 9 lives](https://behzad-robot.itch.io/neons-9-lives) )  .  
Using AI for the gamejam was allowed and encouraged so no breaking rules there.  
The idea is to give players a dash more variety of enemies and harder movement.  
This is not a one shot attempt we had tune most features and edit things.

Most of coding comes from Claude(Opus) and Most of artwork is generated by Codex (Sol 6.1)

If you tried the game any comments here or in the main menu's comment section are appreicated.
